## Top 移动信号

- **SKHY**: HBM4 mass production confirmed + Bernstein-style custom HBM rerating thesis ($210–260 fair value); Gartner sees memory TAM hitting $837B in 2026. → Strongest fundamental catalyst in book; supports core AI-memory exposure.
- **RKLB (held via RKLX 2x)**: Q2 beat ($234M rev, $2.36B record backlog, +62% Y/Y) offset by renewed **Neutron delay risk** flagged post-earnings. → 2x ETF amplifies both backlog upside and delay downside; tape currently focused on delay chatter.
- **SPCX (held via SPCH 2x)**: SpaceX announced **Starbase Louisiana** high-cadence launch site; JPMorgan reiterates Overweight $240 PT citing AI ambitions. → SPCH amplifies the AI/starbase narrative; but Einhorn "meme-ification" critique is a sentiment headwind.
- **CRCL**: Analyst PT dispersion widens — Wolfe Underperform $65 (raised from $50), Susquehanna Neutral $92 (raised from $69), Bernstein Outperform $140. → High uncertainty; USDC growth story intact per Bernstein regardless of Clarity Act.

## Per-ticker 简报

- **CRCL**: PT spread $65–$140 — Wolfe bearish, Bernstein very bullish; Bernstein explicitly says USDC momentum decoupled from Clarity Act legislation. Watch whether divergence compresses post-legislation.
- **RKLB**: Strong Q2 backdrop (62% Y/Y rev, record backlog) being undercut by **Neutron delay narrative**; Cramer positive on Mad Money. RKLX 2x means delay headline = ~2x tape pain.
- **SPCX**: Catalyst-rich 48h — JPMorgan Overweight $240 reiteration + Starbase LA announcement; offset by Einhorn valuation criticism ("meme-ification"). SPCH 2x swings both ways on sentiment.
- **SKHY**: HBM4 ramp + custom HBM re-rating thesis ($210–260) + Gartner $837B 2026 TAM call. Wage deal rejection is noise vs structural story.

## 风险 Watch

- **RKLB / RKLX**: Neutron re-delay — confirmed as ongoing risk post-Q2; tape has used this as an excuse to fade.
- **SKHY**: Union wage deal rejected → fresh negotiations; likely contained but adds Korea labor overhang.
- **SPCX / SPCH**: Einhorn publicly questioning SpaceX valuation as "meme-ification" — sentiment risk if more hedge fund voices pile on.
- **CRCL**: Clarity Act outcome binary; Bernstein says immaterial, Wolfe/Street pricing not.
